item.name: Hydra's Breath

effects.title: Miasma
effects.text: Attacks poison enemies, dealing 2.5% of the target's Max HP as Magical Damage per second for 3 seconds.

effects.title: Polycephaly
effects.text: Ranged attacks have a 30% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to 3 nearby enemies with 150 extra range and within a 120 degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal 20 + 75% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects except for Miasma. The primary attack deals 20 + 100% damage of a normal attack.

notes: Attack Range bonuses from Monkey King Bar and Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.
